text:
Fiona: Heads-up  we need a crisp copy pass for the three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private (VPC & on-prem)) before the launch email. Requirements: one-line hero, one-line benchmark hint, webinar CTA + microline, and simple form webhook spec for routing. 11:30 sync to approve.
Sam: I can take benchmarks. Will post canonical p95/p50 strings by 11.
Noah: Ill draft hero variants. Plan to keep them developer-forward and short.
Grace: Legal note: use exact labels: \"Hosted API\", \"Redwood Dedicated\", \"Private (VPC & on-prem)\". Use \"customer-managed keys (CMK)\" and \"audit trail\". Avoid any public $ figures.
FormBot: Meeting created: https://calendar.example/e/5101234567.
Noah: Quick drafts:
Hosted: "Hosted API  launch LLM features without infra ops"
Micro: "p95 ~130ms (chat, 8k)  streaming & usage metrics"
Dedicated: "Redwood Dedicated  reserved GPU lanes for predictable throughput"
Micro: "sustained ~25k tokens/min per pool"
Private: "Private (VPC & on-prem)  run our runtime in your network"
Micro: "CMK, audit trail, and on-prem options"

Noah: CTA options: "Save my seat  live benchmark + Q&A" / "Join demo: perf, rollout, & controls". Microline: "Includes benchmark walkthrough + 15-min office hours."
Sam: For Hosted use lab canonical: "p95 135ms (chat, 8k)". For Dedicated: "22	1-28k tokens/min per pool" (avoid single-point claims).
Grace: Routing rules: bucket by employee_count -> {>=1200: enterprise-sales, 300-1199: AE/SDR, <300: growth-marketing}. Always tag deployment_interest: hosted|dedicated|private. If deployment_interest=="Private" and employee_count>=500 -> escalate to enterprise-sales.
Noah: Sample webhook payload (for forms):
```
{
  "email": "alex@co.com",
  "name": "Alex Co",
  "company": "Co",
  "employee_count": 850,
  "deployment_interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-may-2026"
}
```
Grace: Map deployment_interest -> contact.tags and size bucket -> contact.size_bucket. Also flag leads routed to enterprise-sales with priority=true when Private+size>=500.
Fiona: Action items: Noah finalizes H1 per mode + microline; Sam posts benchmark doc link by 11; Grace opens GH routing spec; Forms to wire webhook and tags. 11:30 sync confirmers: @Sam @Noah @Grace.
Noah: Posting final copy in 20m.
Sam: I'll attach bench links after the 10:45 run.
FormBot: Registration form created: https://forms.example/launch-may-2026  mapped fields: email,name,company,employee_count,deployment_interest,utm_campaign.
Fiona: Thanks team  if we lock copy today we can push to staging and enable hero CTA for the campaign. :rocket:
